planets.name: K2-316 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-316 with a 5.26-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-316 c was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-316. Its orbit and size follow Castro González et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
